name: io.github.agamemnon-coder/purser
title: Purser
description: Read a company's books in Purser: invoices, payments, cash, VAT, approvals. Never approves or pays.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional: 'Bearer <connector token>' from Purser Cloud (Settings, Connect your AI), or 'Bearer purser-demo-read-only' for the demo company. Without it the client signs in by OAuth.
